title: Introduce telemetry-replay harness and release contextualizer
author: Sara Kim
description: This PR introduces a telemetry-replay harness for the model intake pipeline plus a release contextualizer that synthesizes short, stability-weighted changelog fragments for new model onboarding. Motivation: onboarding diffs and perf signatures are often noisy; product owners and engineers need concise, prioritized release notes and deterministic probes that can be replayed locally and in CI to validate regressions. This change bundles three complementary pieces: 1) telemetry-replay harness: canonicalizes and replays sampled telemetry (latency histograms, sequence-length distributions, failure traces) against an intake candidate in a repeatable way; includes a small fixture format and deterministic seed strategy so CI runs produce comparable aggregates; 2) metadata enrichment pipeline: attaches sampled telemetry fingerprints and stability scores to model intake metadata, exposing top-level fields used by the release contextualizer and downstream gating logic; 3) release contextualizer: an automation that consumes model metadata + replay aggregates to generate a one-paragraph release blurb and three short bullet impact statements (latency, accuracy surrogate, compatibility notes) prioritized by a stability-weighted delta metric. Checklist: - [x] telemetry replay core + fixtures - [x] ingestion hook to store telemetry fingerprint on model manifest - [x] release contextualizer CLI and service endpoint - [x] unit and integration tests for deterministic replay - [x] docs: markdown describing harness and manifest fields - [x] Linear link added (ENG-1259). Related: this work complements the perf fingerprinting and changelog-drafter efforts; it is deliberately small in scope (generator + deterministic inputs) so we can iterate. We expect follow-ups to add more heuristics and UI cards in console.

review_comments: Aisha: Can we make the replay fixtures smaller by sampling percentiles instead of raw buckets? Author: implemented a percentile export option in seed_policy.py and added a test explaining accuracy tradeoffs.
Marco: The stability score formula needs a short doc so SRE can validate thresholds. Author: added a docs section and a helper function with comments and examples.
Ling: CI flaky on Windows runner when seeding RNG — looks like os.urandom difference. Author: switched to a portable deterministic RNG and re-ran CI.

Aisha: Suggest adding a lightweight 'preview' mode in console to show the generated blurb without committing; not in scope for this PR but captured ENG-1380. Author: noted and created ENG-1380 in the description.
ci_log_summary: Initial CI run reported a flaky test (runnable RNG seeding) and a lint failure in contextualizer templates. Fixes pushed; subsequent CI run passed all checks (unit, integration, lint, typecheck). Deployment: added a gated k8s Job manifest for replay runs behind a feature flag.
release_notes: Adds a deterministic telemetry replay harness for onboarding, enrichment of intake manifests with telemetry fingerprints and stability scores, and an automated release contextualizer that drafts short, prioritized release notes for new model versions. Initial scoring heuristics are conservative; follow-up work planned for UI integration and threshold tuning.
notes_for_consumers: Consumers can opt-in by enabling 'telemetryReplay' in the intake config. The manifest now contains fields: telemetry_fingerprint_v1, stability_score_v1, replay_summary_url. The CLI allows local deterministic replay for debugging. See docs/model-intake/telemetry-replay.md for examples and the sample notebook in examples/.
manual_steps_after_merge: 1) Run db migration to add telemetry_fingerprint and stability_score columns (migration script included). 2) Flip feature flag 'telemetry_replay_enabled' in staging. 3) Run the replay job against a small cohort to validate CI fingerprints match local runs.
